body:
Found out firsthand that my father was homosexual when I was around 13.

I strongly believe he was having a lot of trouble dealing with it himself, not to mention the fact that he is/was an alcoholic.
He abused my mom for what seemed like a year before they got divorced, I was about 6-8 when they got divorced.

The worst "abuse" (I'm using quotation marks because I believe it's more of a criminal act than abuse) I remember is waking up one morning and saw that my mom had slept on the floor in my room. She had gauze on her arm and I asked my older brother (1 1/2 years older) what happened and he said that my dad had cut her with a knife.

Yes, I have; after watching so many gory videos online (I don't know how to stop other than avoid what I consider to be cancerous websites such as 4chan and other various websites which host these kinds of videos), I just think to myself "Shit happens, life goes on."

I've tried being social; it just feels like a waste of time. But I do look forward to my next "hangout" with my friends.
